id: title:jose-sequeira:write publish outbox rows for creates and attaches

review.posthog_relevance: Adds an operational startup check for warehouse identity ingestion and a batch-insert helper for identity mappings, supporting warehouse-side identity event delivery.
review.reason: The change adds a startup probe to verify the existence of the warehouse identity outbox table, preventing warehouse ingestion failures if the prerequisite is missing. It also introduces a batch-insert helper and documentation for identity mappings. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in warehouse ingestion reliability and identity storage implementation.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of an operational safeguard and implementation of a helper, but the complete set of hunks and their specific implementation details are not fully provided, so the broader systemic impact cannot be fully assessed.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment requested.

observations.posthog_connection: Checks that the person_publish_outbox table exists at identity service startup; this is a prerequisite for the warehouse-side publisher to drain identity mappings. Without this, the warehouse cannot receive identity events, potentially breaking warehouse ingestion. This is an operational safeguard, not a feature. No score assigned.
